contract.center_quantization: nearest integer; ties to even, as upstream annotation rounding
contract.peak_ties: nearest query center, then earliest frame
contract.control: following annotated interval midpoint, same seven-frame window
contract.pair_exclusion: unavailable windows; canonical overlaps another annotated beat window; control overlaps any annotated beat window
contract.change_anchor: nearest annotated beat to each existing change point; ties earliest
contract.ranking_direction: higher beat peak favors canonical over midpoint; higher downbeat head favors downbeat over non-downbeat
